comparison.validated_atom_view: Frozen current C1f checks registered fields and descriptor effect-label expansion.
comparison.raw_field_taint_view: The control checks every concrete top-level argument using the same task grounding, provenance evidence, totalization, and execution path, but omits descriptor effect-label expansion.
comparison.closed_loop: Run the raw-field view on all 321 frozen cases and compare official utility and attack validators with the frozen four-view rows.
comparison.paired_same_call: Apply raw-field and validated-atom decisions to identical effectful calls from all 726 completed no-guard trajectories; this diagnostic is not a closed-loop outcome estimate.

interpretation_rule.experiment_passed: All completion gates pass, independent of whether atom semantics improve outcomes.
interpretation_rule.atom_semantic_runtime_difference: At least one paired same-call decision differs and at least one closed-loop utility or attack-success count differs from registered-field C1f.
interpretation_rule.atom_semantic_runtime_benefit: A paired same-call decision differs and registered-field C1f either has fewer attack successes than raw-field taint, or has equal attack successes and higher benign utility.
interpretation_rule.negative_result: If a runtime difference is absent, atom semantics did not measurably affect this setting. If a difference exists without the defined benefit, runtime gains are not attributed to atom semantics; the atom contribution remains limited to representation and counterfactual-registration evidence.
